data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 冰晶高塔的蓝色花嫁
data.description: 【至高塔冰晶礼堂·黄昏】艾尔菲利亚穿着雪白长袍婚纱站在冰晶拱门下，极长蓝发铺在地面，手里捧着由冰玫瑰组成的花束；她向镜头伸出一朵不会融化的花，严肃表情只在那一刻软成温柔笑意。
data.action: 冰晶礼堂捧不融冰玫瑰，向镜头递出一朵，威严表情化成温柔笑
data.mood: 冰姬只对旧约柔软的花嫁
data.promptProse: Under the highest tower's ice arch, Elfaria Alvis Serfort offers one magically preserved rose from her bouquet toward the viewer. Her snow-white bridal robe has icy-blue embroidery and a crystal veil; long blue hair spreads over the floor as her serious look softens. The vertical medium-full view retains the arch facets behind. Blue-violet sunset refracts through the ice, illuminating rose edges and robe patterns with broken reflections across the floor.
